name: http_failed_body
description: A web tool fails with http_failed status=401 plus the error BODY. The recorded second step acts on the body content (missing_api_key) — possible only if the body reached the model.

steps.note: model branches on the 401 body, not on a bare status

deltas.content: The request failed with HTTP 401 and the body says missing_api_key — set EXAMPLE_API_KEY and retry; do not change the URL.
